sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:37 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Welfare check on Starbucks, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Wyndham Street, scoped out the area finding no issues.
Arrived at the corner of Queen and Shortland Street, area also scoped, no issues found.
Welfare check along Pocket Park, all clear.
Arrived at Fort Street, showing our presence before moving along.
Continuing our patrols due to no activity visible. Checking into stores and businesses along Commerce Street.
Arrived at the corner of Customs and Commerce Street, continuing our way up to wrap around TK Square.

Arrived at check in Commercial Bay, full sweep completed around the area, checked into cafes and convenience stores that are open at the time. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls and incidents to occur.
No issues or vagrants causing any problems or issues.
Welfare check completed along Queens Wharf waterfront, all clear.
Welfare check along OK Gift Shop, all clear.
Welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Arrived at check in corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, location thoroughly checked, all clear.
Welfare check along 17th Albert Street stores, all clear.
Welfare check along Federal Square and The Cathedral Church, walkthrough completed within the area, no issues found.
Welfare check along Hollywood Cafe and Good To Go Supermarket, no issues.
Welfare check along Little Albert's Cafe and The People's Barista, all clear.
Arrived at check in top of Victoria Street, welfare checks being commenced along all stores and businesses within the area, standing by to show our presence before continuing our patrols.
Continuing our patrols due to no concerns identified.
Welfare check along Subway and AA Insurance, all clear.
Welfare check along Mr Barber and City Convenience store, all clear.
Arrived at the corner intersection between Albert and Wellesley Street, no issues found.
Arrived at check in top of Mayoral Drive, full scope around ensuring no vagrants or concerns present.
Welfare check inside Queens Food Court, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Munster Inn and Nando's, all clear.

Arrived at check in Aotea Square, full sweep completed around the area ensuring no issues are visible, checked into Jack's Fried Chicken and Aotea Centre, all clear. Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.
Response call from 131 Queen Street, reported an elderly female with her stroller and a male vagrant sitting in front of their building, requesting assistance to move them along.
Arrived at HQ for a quick restroom break before continuing towards response call.

Arrived at response location, asked the two persons of interest to move along and notified them of the complaints and request that they do not sit in front of their building again. They complied with our request without any issues.
Continuing our patrols due to no activity visible.
Arrived at check in Commercial Bay, full walkthrough within the area ensuring no issues or concerns present, standby for presence to be known while waiting on further response calls.
Welfare checks completed at the following stores:
Arrived at check in Kiwibank, welfare checks made along all stores within the area, all clear.
Arrived at check in bottom of Fort Street, commenced check ins on businesses and stores, with no reports made. Some have given thanks and acknowledgement for trouble reducing.
Standby to show our presence and waiting on further response calls.

Arrived at check in Wilson's Carpark, scoped out the car park for any vagrants. Checked into stores within the area, made a quick follow up on Vape Haven, person of interest has not returned yet. Standby to show our presence before moving along.
Welfare check completed along High Street, O'Connell Lane and Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Welfare check completed along Freyberg Place, no issues found.
Arrived at check in Chancery Square, full walkthrough around ensuring no issues are visible within the vicinity. No issues found, standby for response calls and showing our presence.
Continuing our patrols now and making our way to next check in.
Welfare checks completed along Lorne Street stores and businesses, all clear. Stopping to grab some food for a quick break.
Arrived at check in corner of Lorne and Wellesley Street, quick scope of the area, no problematic issues found.
Taking our first break now and waiting on response calls to occur.
Welfare check along Auckland Library, all clear.
Arrived at check in Aotea Square, full sweep around the location ensuring no issues are present, standby while waiting on response calls to arise.
Leaving standby and continuing to next checkpoint.
Arrived at check in Elliott Street apartment, completed a welfare check inside Elliott Stables, all clear.
Welfare check completed inside Atrium on Elliott and the Food Court, now making our way up towards Crowne Plaza Hotel, all clear.
Arrived at the corner of Albert and Victoria Street intersection, location scoped out for possible trouble, none found.
Arrived at check in Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse Victoria Street, no issues found, stopped in to grab some drinks.
Arrived at the bottom of HQ, standby for presence to be known before making our way upstairs.

Response call from Typo, reported a male vagrant who tried to steal a Bluetooth speaker and shoved it inside his bag. The store employee confronted him and asked him to return it, he complied and handed it back over, but the employee also noticed something else in his pockets; when asked about it the person of interest failed to cooperate in showing. Description: green rain jacket over his head but not wearing it, carrying a black backpack, last seen walking near Canterbury Arcade.

Arrived at response location, staff updated us that it was a sunglass that he possibly took but they isn't certain yet whether it was from their store. On patrol scoping out the area of Canterbury Arcade, High Street and Queen Street for the person of interest.
Unable to find the person of interest, but will keep an eye out in case he returns or tries to commit any more offences to other stores.
Arrived at HQ, taking lunch break and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon shift.
Morning shift completed, no further issues have occurred during this time.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Geared up and commencing welfare patrol up Queen St heading to Aotea Square.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, no issues found to report, continuing patrol heading over to Elliott St.
Elliott St welfare check complete, no issues to report, heading up to Victoria St.
Arrived at Victoria St, commencing welfare sweeps.
Welfare sweep on Victoria St complete, no issues to report. 77 Convenience Victoria St clear, no issues to report. Headed to the Cathedral.
Federal St / the Cathedral welfare check complete, no issues to report.
Response call from Recycle Boutique on Darby St requesting a standby as there are individuals in store under the suspicion of theft. Heading there now.
Standing down from Recycle Boutique as the individuals have taken leave and have not taken anything. No calls nor issues to report. Resuming patrol down Queen St.
Full sweep on lower Queen St, Vulcan Lane, Shortland St complete, no issues to report, heading over to Commercial Bay.
Full sweep on Commercial Bay, no issues to report, continuing patrol. Welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, clear, no issues to report.
Commerce St, Tyler St clear, no issues, heading over to Gore St.
Gore St and Fort St welfare checks clear, no issues to report:
All clear, no issues. Heading to Chancery Square via High St.
First half of High St before Freyberg Sq clear, no issues to report.
Response call from Lovisa regarding 2 counts of theft, both last seen walking in opposite directions of Queen St. Conducting a sweep whilst keeping an eye out for the offenders.
No issues to report, all welfare checks clear on lower and upper Queen St, security presence maintained, no further issues.
Heading back to HQ for 1st guard stand down.
1st guard standing down, standing by HQ whilst Ops Phone is charging as the battery is on 10%.
2nd guard standing down, no further issues. Handover guards will continue afternoon reports until 10pm, no further issues to report.
Received to let in standby guard inside office. Standing by in office to charge the work Ops Phone due to low percentage (will be shown on work camera).
Full sweep Elliott St, Darby St, welfare check Darby Station, Elliott Stables, all clear, no issues to report, heading down to headquarters to let in standby guard.
Standby guard all clear, no further issues, waiting in office till nightshift guard handover.
Afternoon shift concluded, handover to nightshift.

Full sweep lower Queen Street, Shortland St, Fort St, Fort Lane, welfare check Shortland Mart, lower 77 Convenience store and all businesses open on Fort Lane, all clear, no further issues to report, heading down to Britomart for a full sweep.

Full sweep Britomart, welfare check McDonald's and other businesses open in the vicinity, all clear, no further issues to report, continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign n Pour, not much footwork in the area, all clear, no issues to report, heading back to HQ for 3rd guard.
Received a call from management (Hasi) to make our way up to headquarters to let him and standby guards inside the premises, en route to location.
Arrived at headquarters, standing by for arrival.
Assistance all clear, no issues to report, heading inside office to charge Ops work phone due to low percentage, responding to calls whilst waiting.
Welfare check Bar 101 and guards, all clear, no further issues to report, continuing patrols down lower Queen.
Welfare check Sapphire Nightclub, Fort Lane, KFC, all clear, no further issues to report, heading towards Britomart.
Arrived at Britomart. Welfare check McDonald's and guard, all clear, no further issues to report.

Encountered a group of minors fighting a male adult, quickly intervened and stopped the fight from further escalation (photos will be shown after shift). Male adult has left after seeing security presence, all clear, no further issues to report.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign n Pour, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Quay Street, all clear, no issues to report, heading up Albert Street.
Removed alcohol from male individual drinking in public on Albert Street.
Full sweep half of Albert Street, welfare check Ace Karaoke bar, all clear, no issues to report, heading to Federal / St Patricks Square for a sweep around the area and to identify any issues.
Arrived at location, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep St Patricks / Federal Square, Cathedral, Liston House, all clear, no issues to report, patrolling through Federal Street.
Full sweep Federal Street, welfare check 77 Convenience store, heading down Albert Street to Mayoral Drive.
Full sweep other half of Albert Street, Mayoral Drive, no issues identified in the area, arriving at Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing full sweep around the area and standing by due to a group of individuals suspected of consuming illegal substances.
Full sweep Aotea Square, stand down standby, group of individuals have left the area walking down Queen Street to Bar 101 till closing.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues to report, heading to Bar 101.
Arrived at Bar 101, standing by showing presence till closing then continuing patrols.
Check on Darby St and Elliott Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Victoria St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience store, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Federal St towards Wyndham Street, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling down Wyndham St towards Queen St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Q Convenience store and Custom Mart, all clear, no issues, heading to Fort St.
Sweep Fort Lane, Fort St, and the bottom of High St, all clear, no issues, walking up High Street.
Welfare check on High St Supermarket and street, all clear, no issues, heading to Freyberg to commence full sweep.
Arrived at Freyberg Square, commencing full sweep around the area.
Full sweep around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square, upper High Street, all clear, no issues identified, heading up Lorne Street.
Full sweep whole of Lorne Street and square centre, all clear, no issues identified, heading to McDonald's Queen Street for a welfare check.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, no issues identified, heading to headquarters to commence 30 minute break.

A call from McDonald's Britomart was made but it ended quickly. Called back but they did not answer; a few minutes later McDonald's called back saying they had a disturbance but it was settled and was no longer needed for our assistance, all clear, no further issues to report.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing 30 minute break, responding to any calls whilst on our break.
Night shift concluded, handing over to morning shift.
